messages.content: Return only a concise code-review verdict. A PASS must have no action items. Report only concrete reproducible counterexamples from the exact diff. Maximum 600 words.

Review this exact staged FG-177 status-only cleanup halt ownership repair. Requirements: every hosted call is observed through fresh per-call Failed/status cells; during inherited FinallyUnwind permission, a terminal Failure/Aborted introduced by that exact call must become a new catch-opaque unwind owner, suppress same-block successors, execute nested finally, transfer through wrapper/retry ownership, and commit the precise masked diagnostic and status once if it escapes. A successful cleanup which only observes an inherited failure must continue; Unstable must remain nonterminal; measured sh and missing-unstash AbortException paths remain catchable. Audit all 14 descriptor policies, status/diagnostic precedence, nested finally/return, retry, durable terminal replay, accidental duplicate narration, receipts, and false-positive tests. Return VERDICT and ACTION ITEMS.

+The same unwind ownership applies when a cleanup step marks the observed child
+Failed/status and returns normally instead of throwing. A pinned 2.568.1 matrix
+over `archiveArtifacts`, `junit`, `git`, `stash`, empty `unstable`, `dir`,
+`timeout`, `retry`, and `withEnv` showed that Jenkins suppresses the successor
+cleanup call while Fogell previously ran it; non-empty `unstable`, which reports
+`UNSTABLE` rather than a terminal failure/abort, continues on both engines. The
+host now observes every call through fresh status/Failed cells. During inherited
+finally permission, only a terminal status introduced by that exact call becomes
+a new catch-opaque unwind owner; a successful cleanup which merely observes the
+older failed context is not misclassified. The tier-1 receipts
+`fg177-cleanup-status-halt`, `fg177-cleanup-status-nested-finally`, and
+`fg177-cleanup-status-retry` prove direct successor suppression and workspace,
+nested-finally ownership, and both retry attempts. The descriptor test exhausts
+all 14 hosted rows: only the separately measured `sh` and missing-`unstash`
+AbortException paths remain catchable, while every other fresh terminal status
+uses the deferred owner. The escaping status is committed once with its precise
+failure/abort class and masked diagnostic, preserving durable retry/replay state
+without duplicating step narration.
+
 ## 2. Proven genuine-null returns — unblocked by slice 1, not implemented here
 
 Model a distinct `GenuineNull` return contract for plain `sh`, `echo`,

+echo "=== FG-177: a status-only cleanup halt owns durability and terminal replay ==="
+SH_LANE="$LANE/fg177-status-cleanup-diagnostic"
+mkdir -p "$SH_LANE/ws"
+cat > "$SH_LANE/Jenkinsfile" <<'JF'
+pipeline {
+    agent any
+    stages {
+        stage('status-cleanup-diagnostic') {
+            steps {
+                script {
+                    try {
+                        stash(name: 'original')
+                    } finally {
+                        archiveArtifacts(artifacts: 'missing/**')
+                        sh 'printf wrong > wrong.txt'
+                    }
+                    sh 'printf continued > continued.txt'
+                }
+            }
+        }
+    }
